name: Responsable des fours
description: Heavyset adult with thick neck and immense shoulders, shoulder-length thick black tendrils. FULL black thermal biomask hides face and mouth, heavy bronze horizontal brow, narrow recessed eye slits, two broad vertical cheek filter plates and short attached breathing hose. Thick padded black jacket, bronze chest plate, very wide dark leather apron. Holds a short heavy furnace-door latch tool across both hands; practical back-mounted closed cooling canister. Sturdy wide stance.
